changelog:
Initial release: Enables privacy-safe, allow-listed Google Drive access.

- Browse, search, and read files only within admin-approved folders.
- Upload files to approved folders if permissions allow.
- Easily list folders and their permissions.
- Admins can add or remove allowed folders.
- Ensures no access to any files outside the approved set.
